safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold notes possible urticaria/hives; generated assessment does not mention urticaria/hives.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting mention of possible urticaria/hives removes a relevant differential and characterization of the reaction (cutaneous-only vs evolving anaphylaxis), which can affect clinical framing and follow-up documentation. However, the encounter still appropriately treats this as potentially serious given breathing symptoms, so immediate safety impact is limited.
